visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A person wearing a black sweatshirt, grey scarf, and black gloves holds a large wooden tray featuring a tall double-patty beef burger with lettuce, egg, and cheese, alongside a generous portion of fries, chicken nuggets, and chicken strips. The background shows a banner for 'BRAVO UNCLE Breakfast house' with a logo of a chef's hat and utensils. (2) A montage of close-up shots shows food preparation: a gloved hand spreads sauce on a bun, beef patties are stacked, and fresh lettuce is layered. Then, a metal scoop pours golden fries and chicken nuggets onto a newspaper-lined tray in a brightly lit kitchen environment. (3) A mug of dark coffee sits on a wooden table next to the completed meal tray. A 'WANTED' style poster on the wall details the 'Food Monster' challenge with prices and rules. (4) A hand holds a blue digital timer displaying '05:00'. The scene shifts to a main character, a young man with glasses and a black beanie, sitting in a restaurant interior with Christmas decorations in the background. (5) The man eats the food rapidly, grabbing nuggets and fries with his hands and taking large bites of the burger. He occasionally drinks from the blue mug. A timer on the table counts down from 5 minutes. (6) The timer reaches 4:59 as the man clears his mouth, signaling completion. He holds up a handful of pink $50 vouchers and NT$100 bills. The final shot shows the restaurant exterior at night with a blue address overlay.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) A loud, celebratory 'Woo!' vocalization opens the track, accompanied by upbeat, high-energy pop music featuring a prominent bass synth and electronic drum beat. A male narrator begins speaking with a bright, professional, and fast-paced delivery. (2) A metallic scrape SFX occurs as food is prepared, followed by a soft percussive impact sound when a tray is set down. The BGM remains steady at 115 BPM. (3) A distinct 'ding' bell sound effect triggers when the timer is shown. The narrator's speech rate increases as he explains the rules. (4) Wet chewing and swallowing sounds are audible alongside occasional liquid slurping as the subject drinks. A faint electronic click SFX punctuates the start of the eating sequence. (5) The narrator's voice drops in volume slightly during descriptive segments but maintains a high pitch variability. Paper rustling sounds accompany the showing of vouchers and cash at the end. The music ends on a crisp, resolved chord.
